declaration.preface: The objective of this Responsible Business Conduct Policy is to establish a structured framework for promoting ethical, transparent, and responsible business conduct across all operations of R L Fine Chem Pvt. Ltd. The Company is committed to conducting its business with integrity, accountability, fairness, and compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards while preventing unethical practices that may adversely impact the Company, its stakeholders, and its reputation.
declaration.declaration: I hereby acknowledge my commitment to adhere to the Responsible Business Conduct Policy and contribute towards fostering a culture of integrity, transparency, accountability, fairness, and ethical business conduct throughout the organization.
declaration.scope: This Policy applies to all operations of R L Fine Chem Pvt. Ltd., including its Registered Office, Corporate Office, Manufacturing Plants, laboratories and all associated business activities. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contract employees across all functions, as well as suppliers, contractors, service providers, and other stakeholders directly or indirectly associated with the Company.

Conflict of Interest: We will strengthen conflict of interest management by implementing a formal declaration and approval system for employees, management, and directors.
We will enhance transparency in decision-making by maintaining a centralized conflict of interest register to record, track, and monitor disclosed conflicts.
We strive to ensure procurement, supplier selection, and contracting decisions remain fair, objective, and free from personal influence.
We will enhance employee awareness of conflict-of-interest risks through regular communication and training initiatives.
We strive to ensure that personal relationships, financial interests, and external engagements do not compromise professional judgment.
We are committed to safeguarding the integrity of recruitment, promotion, and performance management processes through merit-based decision-making.
We will promote early identification of conflicts by incorporating conflict of interest checks into employee onboarding, annual compliance reviews, and vendor engagement processes.
Information Protection and Security: We are committed to enhancing employee awareness of information security risks and cybersecurity best practices.
We strive to maintain secure storage, transmission, and disposal of sensitive information through encryption, secure backup systems, and data retention and destruction procedures.

We will strengthen information security by implementing advanced cybersecurity technologies such as multi-factor authentication (MFA), endpoint protection, and network monitoring systems to safeguard critical business and operational data.
We will strengthen cybersecurity resilience by deploying endpoint protection, firewall systems, antivirus solutions, and continuous network monitoring
We are committed to enhancing employee awareness of information security risks through regular cybersecurity training, phishing simulations, and awareness campaigns.
Fraud and Misconduct: We will strengthen oversight of procurement and payment processes by implementing maker-checker controls, vendor due diligence procedures, and multi-level approval systems to prevent fraud and unauthorized transactions.
We will promote transparency and accountability by implementing secure whistleblower channels and structured investigation procedures for reporting and addressing suspected fraud or misconduct.
We strive to enhance employee awareness of fraud risks through regular ethics, compliance, and anti-fraud training programs.
We are committed to encouraging employees and stakeholders to report suspected fraud or misconduct through confidential and secure reporting mechanisms.
We will promote accurate recordkeeping and transparent documentation practices to reduce opportunities for manipulation, misrepresentation, or concealment of information.
Protected Disclosure: We will strengthen confidentiality and data protection in whistleblowing processes by implementing secure reporting, recordkeeping, and access-control measures for complaint management.
We will protect whistleblowers from retaliation, discrimination, harassment, or adverse employment actions resulting from good-faith reporting.
We will ensure that all grievances and complaints are handled confidentially, fairly, and impartially.
We strive to ensure that all whistleblowing concerns are reviewed objectively, investigated impartially, and addressed in a timely manner.
We aim to strengthen employee awareness of whistleblowing mechanisms through regular communication, training, and awareness initiatives.
Anti-Money Laundering: We will enhance the detection and prevention of suspicious transactions by implementing transaction review processes, red-flag identification mechanisms, and escalation procedures for potential money laundering risks.

We strive to strengthen Know Your Customer (KYC) and Know Your Business Partner (KYBP) practices by verifying the identity, ownership structure, and legitimacy of customers, suppliers, agents, and other business associates.
We strive to maintain accurate, complete, and transparent financial records to support accountability and regulatory compliance.
We aim to enhance employee awareness of money laundering risks, suspicious transactions, and reporting obligations through regular training and communication.
We aim to strengthen third-party risk management through screening and verification of high-risk counterparties where appropriate.
Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption: We will promote ethical business conduct by implementing financial controls, approval hierarchies, segregation of duties, and transaction monitoring processes to prevent bribery and corrupt practices.
We aim to strengthen anti-bribery and anti-corruption awareness through regular training, communication, and ethical leadership initiatives.
We will implement risk-based due diligence processes for third parties to identify and mitigate potential bribery and corruption risks.

We aim to comply with all applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws and regulations, including the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, the Companies Act, 2013, and other relevant statutory requirements.
We will monitor gifts, hospitality, donations, sponsorships, and other business courtesies to ensure they are legitimate, transparent, and compliant with Company requirements.
Ethical Conduct: Do act honestly, fairly, and transparently in all business dealings and interactions.
Do comply with all applicable laws, regulations, Company policies, and ethical standards.
Do report suspected misconduct, fraud, bribery, corruption, conflicts of interest, or other unethical behavior through designated reporting channels.
Do maintain accurate, complete, and truthful records, documents, and financial information.
Do disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest that may influence business decisions.
Do conduct business with suppliers, customers, contractors, and business partners based on merit, quality, and objective criteria.
Do treat colleagues, customers, suppliers, and stakeholders with dignity, respect, and professionalism.
Do protect confidential information, intellectual property, and Company assets from unauthorized use or disclosure.
Do seek guidance from management, Human Resources, or Compliance personnel when facing ethical dilemmas or uncertainties.
Do participate in ethics, compliance, anti-corruption, and related awareness programs as required.
Don't offer, promise, give, solicit, or accept bribes, kickbacks, facilitation payments, or any improper advantage.
Don't falsify, manipulate, conceal, or destroy business records, financial information, or documentation.
Don't engage in fraud, embezzlement, theft, or misuse of Company funds, assets, or resources.
Don't use your position for personal gain or provide preferential treatment to family members, friends, or associates.
Don't conceal conflicts of interest or participate in decisions where personal interests may compromise objectivity.
Don't discriminate against, harass, intimidate, or retaliate against any employee or stakeholder.
Don't share confidential information with unauthorized individuals or use it for personal benefit.
Don't ignore, suppress, or discourage the reporting of genuine ethical concerns or policy violations.
Don't circumvent established approval, procurement, financial, or compliance procedures.

policy.monitoring: RL Fine Chem shall monitor and periodically report ethics and compliance-related performance, including adherence to ethical standards, anti-corruption measures, conflict of interest disclosures, whistleblower complaints, fraud prevention activities, ethics training participation, and compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Employees and stakeholders are encouraged to report concerns, suspected misconduct, or policy violations through designated reporting channels. All reported matters shall be reviewed and addressed confidentially, fairly, promptly, and without retaliation against individuals who raise concerns in good faith.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Policy shall be reviewed annually, or earlier if required, by the Top Management to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with applicable legal, regulatory, ethical, and business requirements. Any necessary revisions shall be approved by the appropriate authority and communicated to all relevant employees and stakeholders.
